title: Coefficient confidence failure-bit identity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P\subseteq[n]$, let $k$ be a natural, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\delta\leq1/2$. Let $\mathcal F$ be the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ having size at most $\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$. The number of failure bits at confidence $\delta/(4|\mathcal F|)$ is exactly $\lceil\log_2\!\left(\left\lceil 8|\mathcal F|/\delta\right\rceil\right)\rceil$.
